lines.text: I was babysitting twins. They were asleep upstairs, and the monitor was on the couch beside me.
lines.beat_before: hook: the monitor in my hands, night vision: two cribs, the mobile turning, and something too thin standing perfectly still in the dark corner

lines.text: Shhh... They're sleeping. Don't come up.
lines.beat_before: the monitor: the sound lights jump in a silent room; the voice comes through the speaker

lines.text: The sound lights started jumping. Up there, nothing was moving. And the voice was right up against the microphone.
I panned the camera to the door, and back. Something tall was bent over the crib, looking down at them.
lines.beat_before: I pan to the door (empty) and back: it is bent over the left crib, folded at the hips, its face over the baby

lines.text: I ran up and hit the light. Nobody. They were both asleep. Then I looked at the monitor in my hand.
lines.beat_before: up the stairs; the door; the light: the nursery lit, nobody, the twins asleep
